name: AVERAGEIFS
description: AVERAGEIFS calculates the average of cells that satisfy multiple criteria.
tldr: Averages values that meet all of the specified conditions.

parameters.name: average_range
parameters.description: The range of cells to average.

parameters.name: criteria_range1
parameters.description: The range to evaluate with the first criteria.

basicExample.description: Average sales in the East region

advancedExamples.title: Multiple criteria
advancedExamples.description: Average Widget sales in the East region

howItWorks: AVERAGEIFS evaluates each criteria pair with AND logic. Rows that satisfy all conditions have their corresponding value in average_range included in the average.

howToSteps.name: Press Enter
howToSteps.text: Result appears after all conditions are applied.

limitations: All criteria ranges must match average_range in size.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: AVERAGEIFS works identically in Google Sheets.
googleSheetsEquivalent.notes: Same syntax and behavior as Excel.

faq.question: Can AVERAGEIFS use OR logic?
faq.answer: No, it uses AND logic. For OR, add multiple AVERAGEIFS results.

faq.question: What is the maximum number of criteria pairs?
faq.answer: Excel supports up to 127 range/criteria pairs.

faq.question: Can criteria be cell references?
faq.answer: Yes, use the cell reference directly without quotes.
